reported_symptom: Screen blinks intermittently while desktop is idle; maintainer described "the screen just blinks from times to times".

boot.interpretation: Recurrence of T700 startup failure before Blent daemon starts. Existing isolated evidence reproduces failure without EVDI. AMD timeout alone does not establish the cause of ongoing idle flicker.

idle.passive_observation: 45 seconds; no RandR events or DRM uevents; no correlated user flash timestamp
limits: Disconnected outputs and a quiet daemon do not rule out effects of loaded EVDI/Xorg providers.
Zero events without a matched visible flash is not proof that flickering stopped.
Some EDID re-probes coincide with our xrandr provider/property queries; these cannot be treated as spontaneous hotplug evidence.
idle.next_evidence: A maintainer-observed blink with a timestamp. The 60-second pause was not watched and is inconclusive; do not infer absence of blinking. Correlate the next reported event before arranging another observed comparison.

user_observation.reported: I was not following it, so, I do not know but I assume no
user_observation.reason: No visual observation; an assumed absence of blinking is not a measured negative.

checks.scope: Existing T700 boot-order regressions; not an idle-flicker regression or native reboot acceptance.

changes: Repository ledger/artifacts plus a 60-second idle blent.service stop/start comparison; daemon restored and running. No module, boot or display configuration changes.
